text:
tom: Hey all — onboarding question. We have a contractor starting Monday and they need to contribute to Product ramp notes. What's the recommended way to give temporary edit access without adding them to the org-wide editors group?

annie: we usually add contractors to a time-limited group (e.g., contractors-product) and set expiry in the access tool. People Ops can create it if you don't have perms.

tom: i don't see an option to invite external emails in Notion. is that blocked?

people-ops: external guests are allowed but must be invited from the org admin panel. ping me the email and duration and we can add them. also confirm if they need page-level or workspace-level edit.

tom: just page-level for Product > Onboarding > Ramp note for that feature. want to avoid giving wider edit access.

annie: ok — best practice: duplicate the ramp-note template into Product > Contractors > <name>-ramp and grant page-level access. automations still pick up the frontmatter as long as you don't paste content between pages (duplicate only).

marco: fyi we had an automation failure last month when someone copied blocks into a new page instead of duplicating. the page properties (template metadata) were missing so the ingestion lambda skipped it.

tom: how do I duplicate without losing the template properties? When I duplicate the template the page uid in the URL still changes and the automation complains sometimes.

annie: duplication always creates a new page id. automations rely on two things: (1) presence of the frontmatter properties (owner, team, template-version) and (2) the page existing under the expected path (Product > Onboarding). If you duplicate and move, make sure to fill the frontmatter fields.

devex-bot: Reminder: Use the Product Ramp Note template and fill the "template-version" property. Missing property triggers: "ingest:missing-metadata".

marco: if you prefer we can run a quick CLI command from devex-tools to patch the properties automatically after duplication. ping me and i'll run it.

tom: that would be great — i'll duplicate now and ping you. One last Q: can contractors create pages in Product > Contractors by default?

people-ops: no, not by default. we'll create a restricted subspace "Product / Contractors" and give them create/edit on that subspace only. that avoids polluting main Product pages.

tom: perfect. scheduling: marco — i'll ping you at 10:15 to run the property patch. thanks folks.

annie: also adding a short note to onboarding docs: "When adding contractors, duplicate template -> move to Product / Contractors -> run devex-tools patch -> confirm ingest status in Console > Docs". saves future headaches.

tom: noted. closing the loop.
